48.original: Well, a well-wishing welcome to you, adventurer friend! You've worked your way to Fisherman's Bottom.

49.original: When you want fish for just a day, you can call a culinarian, but we fishermen feast for life!

50.original: I've set the bait. Think you're ready to bite?

51.original: Do you wish to join the Fishermen's Guild?

54.original: Oh? Here I hastily hoped to hook you in, but I suppose I'll find other fish in the sea.

55.original: Feel free to swim back if ever fish fit your fancy!

56.original: Oops! I hooked you only to find a snag─it appears you're on course for a different dock.

57.original: I really hate to release such a considerable catch, but here's to hoping you swim back once you've grown into your gills!

58.original: Before you can take up another discipline, you must first complete the level 10 quest of your starting class.

59.original: Hooray, hooray! Looks like we've got a live one! Let me walk you through the life of a fisherman in Limsa Lominsa.

60.original: Since we're surrounded by the seas, the fishing sites are a fisherman's delight. If you can't fish it here, you can't fish it anywhere!

61.original: While some of us rope our fish in with rods and reels, others skim the seabed with nets for creepy-crawly critters.

62.original: You might say we cast a wide net─people prattle about our pullers just about everywhere in Limsa.

63.original: And there's much and more I haven't mentioned. We shepherd the ships, preside over the ports, manage the mongers, all while making sure not to leave any adventurers out to sea.

64.original: I'll wager you prefer to work alone, so we'll start you off with the rod and reel.

65.original: Now, you may not necessarily net the numbers net-fishing yields, but pole-fishing positively pulls prettier prizes.

66.original: And that's the long and short of it! When you're ready for another bite of bait, I'll reel you in before the guildmaster!
